paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Shabbat 66a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.66a.7-8), challenging Rav Yosef’s words: “They have not heard what Rav Chanan bar Rava taught Chiyya bar Rav.”[^1]

notes.text: Rav Yosef speaks first. Rava bar Shira then asks whether the others heard Rav Chanan bar Rava teach Chiyya bar Rav in Rav’s presence. [Heilprin’s fuller notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3160&lang=en) lists the Rava and Rabbah forms and cites the objection to Rav Yosef.
